description:
Found by s532c (s536, 2026-11-08) while fixing #4308.  Pre-existing: ce665621 dies the same way on the
PAREN form; since #4308 the paren-less `for (substr $h{k}, 0, 1)` takes the same cell (it used to copy
silently), so both spellings now die on the write.  READS through the cell work (`for (substr $h{k}, 1, 1)
{ print }` prints the window).
Reproducer (perl 5.40.3: `hBC` / `XYz`):
    my %h = (k => "ABC"); for (substr($h{k}, 0, 1)) { $_ = "h" } print "$h{k}\n";
    my @a = ("XYZ"); for (substr($a[0], 2)) { $_ = "z" } print "$a[0]\n";
Emission: `(p-foreach ($_ (p-substr-lvalue-cell (p-gethash %h "k") 0 1)) (p-scalar-= $_ "h"))` -- the cell
macro is handed the element VALUE, not its box, so the write has no place.  Start: the cell's first
argument wants the element's box form (`p-gethash-box` / `p-aref-box`, the sibling element rewrite in
`_foreach_alias_rewrite`), as `\substr($h{k},...)` would need too -- check that spelling first.

CHECKED (s532c): `my $r = \substr($h{k}, 0, 1); $$r = "q"` WORKS (perl and PCL both qBC) -- the `\substr`
rewriter (#3141's one form) already hands the cell a writable element; the foreach site does not.  Route the
foreach magic-lvalue element through that same form rather than adding a second one.  The @a reproducer is
confirmed too (perl XYz, PCL dies).

=== DONE (s536b) ===
FIXED (s536b, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08; commit 2297ff0e).  Pl/Parser2.pm _alias_box_form: when the foreach head swap is a magic-lvalue builtin (`p-substr` / `p-pos` / `p-vec` -> `-lvalue-cell`, s532c's _magic_lvalue_call_head), the cell is built by ExprToCL's `_write_through_form` -- the one rewriter `\substr(...)` and a sub argument (#3141) use -- so its TARGET argument becomes a place: `(p-gethash %h "k")` -> `(p-gethash-box %h "k")`, the deref pair -> `-deref-box`.  No second rewriter.
Probe scratch/s536b/p/f1.pl: both spellings (paren and paren-less), hash / array / through a ref, a named loop var, a read-only use, vec: tree = perl.  Guard: Pl/t/lvalue-ref-01.t row 21 (perl-probed text), inverse-verified on 0affbe86.
NOT fixed, FILED #4581: a foreach list of SEVERAL such calls (`for (substr($s,0,1), substr($t,1))`) still goes through the flattener and loses the writes (pre-existing, also for plain scalars).


=== COMPLETED (s536, reviewing session, 2026-11-08) === merged as MAIN-READY-79 352e26e0 (s536b); review probes perl -> main 84a2e6ec -> tree (scratchpad p536b/a.pl): tree = perl on 8 lines (main: `d=DEF` for a BEGIN-block constant, died at the first @{} deref); no live baseline row keys on this task (CLOSE-WITH-ROWS checked).
subject: `for (substr($h{k}, 0, 1)) { $_ = "h" }` DIES "Modification of a read-only value attempted" -- a foreach substr cell over an ELEMENT argument is not writable (perl writes $h{k})
